General frustration with the process.
I wonder if we could put this in dbus_utils or something? Oh well, I am good with this and it moves to sdbusplus::message::object_path
Done. Also put it in all places I could find.
I am good here, want Ed to weigh in

I'd like to see some articulation of "why" here.  Having to reference another file to find a path makes it harder to debug.  That's fine if we have a good technical reason, but this path:
1. Isn't going to change anytime soon.
2. Definitely isn't going to change in one shot.

So having one spot for this makes our ability to change worse.

It does ensure these are correct. 
It also moves all of these to sdbusplus::message::object_path.
I rewrote the commit message to better reflect whats going on and why.
These also help the case if you want to add to the commit msg

> It does ensure these are correct.

Have we had cases where they weren't correct?  Just having a single global string doesn't help much.  If there's an API for doing these calls that's common, I could see the argument that that's better.
Not really much of a test.. But oh well, seems correct.

It would be better if we can add `constexpr`, but `boost::message::object_path` would not work.

Then, should we add `static` so that the var is instantiated once per compile unit?

```
static const sdbusplus::message::object_path inventoryPath(
    "/xyz/openbmc_project/inventory");
```
Done

In addition to this line, there are another lines that can be changed.

- `getDimmData()`  - https://github.com/openbmc/bmcweb/blob/d9495964cd857f8775677f3f5c1f35f0cf00c0a6/redfish-core/lib/memory.hpp#L822

- `handleMemoryCollectionGet` - https://github.com/openbmc/bmcweb/blob/d9495964cd857f8775677f3f5c1f35f0cf00c0a6/redfish-core/lib/memory.hpp#L997
Done
It seems good to me

Lets start by inlining the path (which is what we should've done in the first place.).

https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/85530

After that we can decide if we want to remove all these into some common method.  If we're doing to do that, just putting these in some common global I don't think improves the readability here.

https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/bmcweb/+/85364/1

I almost had it in the first patchset. Closing this, because I dont care, I just want to get the multi-host hardware inventory changes in.
